integrity: Standalone checker uses bounded exact arithmetic, not infinite certification; the general theorem is supported by the algebraic proof. No external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one omitted Segre coordinate, integers a,b>=2, complex closed points, reduced singular locus. No conclusions for arbitrary deletion patterns or the nonreduced Jacobian scheme. Existing broad rank-one completion and toric-projection methods may contain an unindexed equivalent specialization.
title: Singular strata and a small resolution for one-entry-deleted Segre toric varieties
